name: dsh-codex-conductor
description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: hand coding tasks to Codex CLI in WSL with acceptance criteria and per-criterion reports, and keep the agent itself to planning and read-only verification.

scripts.test: node --test test.mjs workflow.test.mjs runtime.test.mjs panel.test.mjs client-panel.test.mjs resume.test.mjs planner.test.mjs verify.test.mjs guard.test.mjs gemini.test.mjs safeguards.test.mjs closeout.test.mjs convergence.test.mjs handover.test.mjs autoanswer.test.mjs worktree.test.mjs && (python3 runner/test_codex_runner.py || python runner/test_codex_runner.py) && (python3 runner/test_agy_runner.py || python runner/test_agy_runner.py)
